source: City of Yarra (Melbourne), Significant Trees register
licence_proof: data.gov.au package metadata for dataset 'yarra-significant-trees' (package_show, id 4b950f69-8816-45a7-8788-951d788287bd) reads verbatim: license_title 'Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International', license_url 'http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0'. Fetched 2026-08-15.
designation: Trees within the City of Yarra municipality 'identified and assessed (against defined categories) as having scientific, social, historic and aesthetic value' (dataset description, verbatim)
scope: 232 point records across the City of Yarra local government area (inner Melbourne: Fitzroy, Collingwood, Richmond, Abbotsford, Clifton Hill, Carlton North, Alphington), all within a few kilometres of Melbourne's CBD. Species, common name, DBH, height, maturity, age (where recorded), significance category and a 'location' field (park/street/private-style values) are present per record. NOT clustered or filtered to a walkable subset; that is city-pass work. A 'location' field exists per record but its values were not exhaustively enumerated this pass; check per tree before publishing (hard rule 10) rather than assuming public land from the presence of a park/street address.
caveat: No explicit vitality/condition field. 'age' is text ('100+ years' etc.), not a number; treat as an estimate at last survey (updated field per record, mostly 2012). Coordinates are per-tree WGS84 (lat/lon in properties AND geometry, both checked and consistent). This register is a strong candidate to open or deepen Melbourne: unlike the Exceptional Tree Register (webpage only, not machine-readable, see below), this is a real downloadable dataset.
